s.how: Mix 500g pork mince, 1 grated carrot, 1 finely diced onion, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 egg, 1 tbsp soy and pepper. Lay 2 tbsp of filling along the edge of each of 20 spring roll wrappers in a thin line and roll up tightly, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Mix 100ml white vinegar with 1 crushed garlic clove, chilli and pepper. Serve with the vinegar and sweet chilli sauce.

Soak 250g rice vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Stir-fry 300g sliced chicken thigh and 1 sliced Chinese sausage in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Add 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 julienned carrot and 100g snow peas for 2 minutes. Add 250ml chicken stock, 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp oyster sauce, then the noodles, and toss until absorbed. Serve with lime or calamansi wedges and spring onion.

m.note: Joe's mum and the family Easter lunch
m.how: Brown 1kg bone-in chicken thighs in 1 tbsp oil. Add 8 crushed garlic cloves, 120ml white vinegar, 80ml soy, 3 bay leaves, 1 tsp black peppercorns and 200ml water. Simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, turning, until the sauce is sticky. Fry 600g cold cooked rice with 4 crushed garlic cloves in 2 tbsp oil until crisp in spots. Fry 4 eggs. Serve the adobo over the rice with an egg on top.

w.note: the aunties' dessert table at the Easter party
w.how: Melt 150g caster sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a 20cm dish, tilting to coat. Whisk 6 egg yolks with a 395g tin condensed milk, a 370ml tin evaporated milk and 1 tsp vanilla without making bubbles, then strain over the caramel. Cover with foil and bake in a water bath at 160C for 50 minutes until just set. Cool, chill overnight, then turn out onto a plate.

d.how: Stir 4 tbsp honey into 4 tbsp hot water until dissolved. Squeeze 150ml calamansi juice, or use the juice of 3 limes and 1 mandarin. Mix the juice and honey syrup in a jug and chill. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, add the juice and top with 800ml cold soda water. Garnish with lime wheels.
